text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good. That's a nice time. My<n>accuracy has
improved a great deal<n>too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think it's about time for a break.<n>Whether it's
talking or running, we<n>have to make sure we have
enough<n>energy for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? This is the cafeteria, isn't it?Why does it look so different?
choice_data_list: Maybe they've decorated for the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's right. I didn't even<n>realize it was that
time of year<n>already!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they're serving roast<n>chicken and
seasonal cake. Ooh!<n>Look, they have pizza over
there too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't see any curry, but I suppose<n>that makes
sense, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Um, I know it's not exactly a<n>traditional dish for this
time of year...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But at my house, we always used to<n>make what
everyone liked for our<n>holiday dinner.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd ask my mom to make a fruitcake<n>for me, and
Brian would ask me to<n>make curry for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, she'd always ask at the<n>last minute, but
the thing is, it takes<n>hours to stew the vegetables
for her<n>favorite kind of curry.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, the Arima<n>Kinen falls on a
rather special holiday<n>this year.
choice_data_list: What kind of present are you going to give Brian?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, let's see... I suppose I'll<n>give her the
best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to face her in the Twinkle<n>Series and run
against her in perfect<n>form.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And I'll prevail with my winning<n>equation.
choice_data_list: You can't let her win, huh?
You can't let her win, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. I have my pride to<n>preserve as her
older sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: By the way... what are your favorite<n>foods?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of today and eat<n>our
favorites!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have a<n>wonderfully cheerful
meal together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's so much snow all around. It<n>really makes
for the perfect festive<n>atmosphere.
choice_data_list: You're even dressed kind of like Santa.
You're even dressed kind of like Santa.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're right. I fit right in, don't<n>I?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, tell Santa what you<n>wish for this
year. I might just bring it<n>to you!
choice_data_list: I wish for you to win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Very well. You'll get your wish soon<n>enough.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She smiles confidently at me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have a<n>wonderfully cheerful
meal together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So... Why did you bring me here<n>again?
choice_data_list: I thought maybe you'd like a fruitcake.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You should think about yourself once<n>in a while too.
You're far too indulgent<n>with me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's get two cakes and take them<n>home. One for
me, and one for you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I each get a cake<n>and enjoy
them together.
